title: ormosolenia alpina
intro: Ormosolenia alpina, commonly known as Mountain Spring Bacillus, is a type of freshwater cyanobacterium. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ormosolenia alpina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and immune-modulating effects. Furthermore, Ormosolenia alpina has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various conditions, including wounds, fever, and respiratory issues.
